gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-syriac-: Conthrax draws its wide lowercase a with a pen line that never changes width. Noto Sans Syriac Eastern is the softer partner, with tall lowercase against small caps and curve endings that keep their distance.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Noto Sans Tagalog fills the line with a dense middle zone, its curves leaving generous gaps instead of closing up. The heading's toothpaste-steady stroke makes a crisp partner.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-tagbanw: Noto Sans Tagbanwa reads open and modern, its curves leaving clear gaps while lowercase fills most of the height. Conthrax holds a monoline skeleton; the sans simply keeps text moving.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Conthrax starts with round bowls whose walls never swell or taper. Beside it, the plain sans Noto Sans Tai Le feels gentler, its strokes tapering out before touching and capitals barely stepping up from lowercase.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-tai-vie: Conthrax looks drawn with a fixed pen, wide and geometric. Noto Sans Tai Viet handles the reading, with short ascenders, a tall x-height and terminals pulled back from each curve's closing point.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-takri: Wide, crisp and sharply geometric, Conthrax keeps its curves and stems in lockstep. Noto Sans Takri leaves every small round letter generously unclosed.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Conthrax has bodies so tall its capitals barely rise above them, all drawn with one constant pen width. And Noto Sans Tamil looks magnified without growing, its terminals stopping far from the stem.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-tamil-s: Clean is the mood Conthrax sets, with strokes like fine rope laid into letter shapes. Noto Sans Tamil Supplement gives text round forms like open parentheses and a middle band so tall the line looks stocky.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Wide, hairline-free Conthrax has no swells anywhere in its letterforms. And Noto Sans Tangsa keeps text inviting, with wide openings on its round letters and short ascender stems over tall lowercase bodies.
